title: Nullity action, 15 years from the contract: three days inside the limit

expect.why: Text: «وتسقط دعوى البطلان بمضي خمسة عشرة سنة من وقت إبرام العقد». Start is the contract date (2011-06-15). The text does not say how days are counted, so the last day is 2026-06-14, 2026-06-15 or 2026-06-16 depending on whether the first and last day count; I took 2026-06-15 (anniversary). 2026-06-12 is before every reading, so in time under all of them. Assumes the claim is one of absolute nullity: no slot holds the ground (see reply).

title: Nullity action, 15 years: the day before the anniversary

expect.why: «بمضي خمسة عشرة سنة من وقت إبرام العقد»: the text does not settle this. If the starting day counts, the last day is 2026-06-14 (filing on the last day); if it does not, 2026-06-15; if neither first nor last counts, 2026-06-16. Likelier reading: 2026-06-15. The case must make a rule warn, not decide.

title: Nullity action, 15 years: filed on the anniversary of the contract

expect.why: The text does not settle this: «بمضي خمسة عشرة سنة» does not say whether the day of the contract counts. Last day 2026-06-14 (inclusive) or 2026-06-15 (starting day excluded) or 2026-06-16 (both excluded). On 2026-06-15 the filing is late under the first reading and on the last day under the second. Likelier last day: 2026-06-15.

title: Nullity action, 15 years: the day after the anniversary

expect.why: The text does not settle this: last day 2026-06-14, 2026-06-15 or 2026-06-16 depending on the counting, which the texts given do not state. 2026-06-16 is late under two readings and the last day under the third. Likelier last day: 2026-06-15.

title: Nullity action, 15 years: three days after the anniversary

expect.why: «تسقط دعوى البطلان بمضي خمسة عشرة سنة من وقت إبرام العقد». Under every counting the last day is at most 2026-06-16 (the Monday, so no rest-day shift), and 2026-06-18 is after it. Assumes the ground is absolute nullity (no slot for it).

title: Nullity action, 15 years: the period ends on a Friday

expect.why: 15 years from 2011-06-12 end on 2026-06-12, a Friday. The texts given do not say which days are weekly rest or holidays, nor whether a period ending on one runs to the next working day. If it does (Sunday 2026-06-14, if Friday and Saturday are rest days), filing on Saturday 2026-06-13 is in time; if not, it is late. The text does not settle this. Last day under the reading I think likelier (no extension): 2026-06-12.

title: Ten-year bar on error, fraud or duress: contract made on 29 February, ten years end in a non-leap year

expect.why: «إذا انقضت عشر (10) سنوات من وقت تمام العقد». 2016-02-29 plus ten years: 2026 has no 29 February, so the last day is 2026-02-28 (a Saturday) or 2026-03-01; plus the counting uncertainty of the starting day. The text does not settle this. No slot holds the ground (error, fraud, duress), which the bar needs. Last day I take as likelier: 2026-02-28.

title: Nullity limit runs from the contract, not from a later event

expect.why: «خمسة عشرة سنة من وقت إبرام العقد»: the start is the contract (2010-12-01), so the last day is about 2025-12-01 under any counting, and 2026-06-15 is far after it. A rule that started the period from the record delivered on 2026-05-01 or the notice of 2026-01-10 would say in time. Assumes absolute nullity (no ground slot).

title: Notice served by a bailiff before the day of filing

expect.why: «جاز للمتعاقد الآخر بعد اعذاره المدين أن يطالب بتنفيذ العقد أو فسخه» and [180 ¶1] «يكون اعذار المدين بانذاره». A notice by bailiff on 2026-06-01, before filing, and the contract sets no special terms: the step is done.

title: Notice by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt

expect.why: «ويجوز أن يتم الاعذار عن طريق البريد على الوجه المبين في هذا القانون»: mail is allowed. The form «المبين في هذا القانون» is not in the texts given, so I take the registered letter with acknowledgement as meeting it; the text does not give that form.

title: Notice sent by some other means

expect.why: «بانذاره، أو بما يقوم مقام الانذار»: the text does not say what else stands for a formal notice. The text does not settle this; the rule must warn, not decide.

title: Whether any notice was sent is unknown

expect.why: «بعد اعذاره المدين»: the notice is a condition of rescission, and nothing is known about it, so the rule must ask the lawyer, not assume none was sent.

title: No notice, no exemption

expect.why: «بعد اعذاره المدين»; [179 ¶1] and [181] list the only exemptions («لا ضرورة لاعذار المدين فى الحالات الآتية»). Notice not given and every listed exemption is no: step missing.

title: No notice, but the contract makes the debtor in default at the due date

expect.why: «كما يجوز أن يكون مترتبا على اتفاق يقضي بأن يكون المدين معذرا بمجرد حلول الاجل دون حاجة الى أى اجراء آخر»: the agreement stands in for the notice.

title: No notice, performance made impossible or useless by the debtor

expect.why: «اذا تعذر تنفيذ الالتزام أو أصبح غير مجد بفعل المدين»: no notice is needed.

title: No notice, the debtor declared in writing that he will not perform

expect.why: «اذا صرح المدين كتابة أنه لا ينوى تنفيذ التزامه»: no notice is needed.

title: No notice, one exemption still unknown

expect.why: The step is missing unless an exemption of [180 ¶1] or [181] applies; whether the debtor refused in writing is unknown and could change the result, so the rule must ask.

title: No notice, the obligation claimed is compensation for a harmful act

expect.why: «اذا كان محل الالتزام تعويضا ترتب عن عمل مضر»: read literally it exempts, but rescission rests on a contract term not performed [119 ¶1], and the text does not say whether this exemption reaches a rescission claim. The text does not settle this.

title: Notice served on the very day of filing

expect.why: «بعد اعذاره المدين»: the text does not say whether a notice served the same day as the petition comes 'after' it. The text does not settle this; the rule must warn, not decide.

title: Notice dated after the petition

expect.why: «بعد اعذاره المدين أن يطالب...»: the creditor may claim only after the notice. A notice of 2026-06-20 cannot come before a petition of 2026-06-15, so for this filing the step was not taken.

title: Notice served the day before filing, date is the starting event

expect.why: «بعد اعذاره»: a notice served on 2026-06-14 is before the petition of 2026-06-15. The text gives no waiting period after the notice, so one day is enough on its words.

title: Notice served, but whether the contract sets its own notice terms is unknown

expect.why: [120 ¶1] says the notice is «يحدد حسب العرف عند عدم تحديده من طرف المتعاقدين», so the contract may fix its form. Whether it does is unknown, so the step cannot be called done: ask.

title: A party is a public administrative body

expect.why: The texts given are all from the civil code and contain no rule on which court hears a claim against a public administrative body, so they do not say whether the case leaves the ordinary courts. The text does not settle this; the rule must warn, not decide. (No case 'just inside', e.g. a public company, is written: no outcome of the list says 'stays in the ordinary courts'.)
